description: This file defines the EntityViewDisplay class, a configuration entity in Drupal responsible for managing display options for entities in different view modes. It includes methods for collecting render displays, building render arrays, and managing display plugins.

classes.name: EntityViewDisplay
classes.description: A configuration entity class in Drupal that manages display settings for entities in various view modes, providing methods for rendering, building, and plugin management.

methods.name: collectRenderDisplays
methods.description: Collects and returns display objects used to render a set of entities based on their view mode and bundle.

methods.name: collectRenderDisplay
methods.description: Returns the display object used to render a single entity in a specified view mode.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the display plugin manager and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Resets the cache for the target entity type after saving the display configuration.

methods.name: getRenderer
methods.description: Retrieves or instantiates the renderer (formatter) for a specific field.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a render array for a single entity.

methods.name: buildMultiple
methods.description: Builds render arrays for multiple entities, applying formatters and module alterations.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns plugin collections for formatters used in the display.
